description: Query the tool-call projection (session_ledger__tool_call) populated by the importer's TOOL_CALL/TOOL_RESULT projection. Each row carries the tool_name, the call_event_id (event_type=TOOL_CALL), an optional result_event_id (event_type=TOOL_RESULT once matched), status (pending / succeeded / errored), called_at, resolved_at, and the parent session_id. Optional filters: session_id restricts to one session; tool_name is an exact-match filter; status accepts pending / succeeded / errored; since_iso is an ISO-8601 lower bound on called_at; limit clamps to [1..200] (default 50). Rows are ordered by called_at DESC. Use this verb to answer 'which tools did the LLM call lately and did they all complete' across imported sessions without writing raw SQL against session_ledger__tool_call. Pair with get_session_timeline to follow up on a specific call's full call+result event pair.
embedding_description: Query LLM session ledger tool-call projection (__tool_call). Rows: tool_name, call_event_id, result_event_id (if resolved), status (pending/succeeded/errored), called_at, resolved_at, session_id. Optional filters: session_id, tool_name (exact), status, since_iso, limit (1..200 default 50). Ordered called_at DESC. Answers 'which tools did the LLM call lately + did they complete' without raw SQL.
